description: This file contains an asynchronous function 'listOrganizations' that fetches and processes a list of organizations (tenants) from an API endpoint. It normalizes various possible response formats and sorts the resulting list.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches a list of organizations (tenants) for the current user from the API, normalizes different response formats, and returns a sorted array of organization objects with 'id' and 'name'.
